newsitem.title: UK: Parliament to debate UK budget for four days.
newsitem.headline: Parliament to debate UK budget for four days.

text.p: Parliament will debate Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown's maiden budget, which he will present on July 2, for four days, Leader of the House Ann Taylor told MPs on Thursday.
Next week's business is as follows:
MONDAY, June 30 -- Measure relating to the Scottish Grand Committee. Motion on 1974 Northern Ireland Act Interim Extension Order and motion on satellite television regulations.
TUESDAY, July 1 -- Adjournment debate on international development policies.
WEDNESDAY, July 2 -- Morning adjournment debates followed by Budget speech.
-- Duchy of Lancaster and Prime Minister's questions.
MONDAY, July 7 -- Conclusion of budget debate.
